spans.s:
Māvellaka : m. (pl.): Name of a people.

Their warriors fought on the side of Kauravas; in his report to Dhṛtarāṣṭra after the first seventeen days of war, Saṁjaya mentioned Māvellakas among those who were killed by Arjuna (māvellakās…te hatāḥ samare rājan pārthena…)

, 50.
